description: This file defines a template class 'Multiplexer' for managing multiple queues with thread-safe operations, including registration, pushing, popping, and checking queue states, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: Multiplexer
classes.description: A thread-safe template class managing multiple queues with registration, push, and pop operations.

methods.name: CreateQueue
methods.description: Creates a new queue with provided arguments and returns a unique pointer to it.

methods.name: RegisterQueue
methods.description: Registers a queue and returns its assigned ID.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes an item into the specified queue.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Pops an item from a queue selected either by a custom selector or default round-robin.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a specified queue is empty.

methods.name: SemWait
methods.description: Waits on the semaphore indicating available items.

methods.name: CheckIdx
methods.description: Validates that a queue index is within bounds.
